name: PRD Archive on Completion
description: Automatically archive completed PRDs when the ALL_COMPLETE exit signal is triggered. Creates a prd-archive subfolder and moves completed PRDs from prds/ folder. Also handles prd.json in root by renaming it to standard convention before archiving.

userStories.title: Create prd-archive folder structure
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want a prd-archive folder to exist so completed PRDs have a home
acceptanceCriteria: fade init creates prds/ folder (existing) AND prd-archive/ folder
prd-archive/ is created automatically if it doesn't exist when archiving
.gitkeep in prd-archive/ to ensure empty folder is tracked

userStories.title: Archive completed PRDs from prds/ folder
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want completed PRDs to be moved to prd-archive/ when work finishes so my prds/ folder stays clean
acceptanceCriteria: When ALL_COMPLETE signal is triggered, scan prds/ folder for PRDs where ALL stories have passes: true
Move fully completed PRDs to prd-archive/ folder

userStories.title: Archive prd.json with proper naming
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want prd.json in root to be renamed and archived using standard naming convention so I can track what was completed
acceptanceCriteria: When ALL_COMPLETE and prd.json exists with all stories complete, archive it
Derive TYPE from 'type' field in JSON (feature→FEAT, bug→BUG, etc.)
Derive ID from 'id' field in JSON
Derive slug from 'name' field, lowercased, spaces to hyphens, max 50 chars
Delete original prd.json from root after successful move

userStories.title: Update prompt.md exit protocol
userStories.description: As a FADE maintainer, I want the prompt.md template to include archive instructions so Claude triggers the archive step
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md template includes archive step in Story Completion Protocol
Archive step runs BEFORE outputting ALL_COMPLETE signal
Archive logic: check all PRDs in prds/ and prd.json, move completed ones
Clear documentation of naming convention for prd.json archival
